description: A record-lock phrase on READ/WRITE/REWRITE (ISO 14.9.30/14.9.51/14.9.35; WITH LOCK / WITH NO LOCK / IGNORING LOCK / ADVANCING ON LOCK) - explicit MANUAL locking + the IGNORING-LOCK bypass. 2002 introduction; 0900 below 2002.
display: a record-lock phrase (WITH LOCK / WITH NO LOCK / IGNORING LOCK / ADVANCING ON LOCK)
citation: ISO §2023:14.9.30.2 / §2023:14.9.51.2 / §2023:14.9.35.2 (the LOCK phrases of the general formats); 2002 introduction; §2023:14.9.30.3 SR4
vcr: 2002 introduction (derive from the 2002 standard - Annex E covers 2014->2023 only)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. ROWRL.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT F ASSIGN TO "f.dat" ORGANIZATION IS RELATIVE
               ACCESS MODE IS RANDOM RELATIVE KEY IS K
               LOCK MODE IS MANUAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD F.
       01 R PIC X(8).
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 K PIC 9(4).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           MOVE 1 TO K.
           READ F WITH LOCK.
           STOP RUN.
